meta_description: Leave, authorisations, assignments, time by project.
review_not_found: This draft does not exist, or you may not decide it.
feedback_error: That did not work. Try again.
error_generic: That did not work. Try again.
perm_journal_read_body: See who did what in the app, agents included.
ask_intro: Ask a question: the assistant answers with what you may read, and changes nothing.
ask_not_connected: No model is connected: the assistant cannot answer.
ask_budget_spent: This month’s AI budget is spent.
errors_not_allowed: You may not do this. Ask the owner.
errors_invalid_input: What was entered does not fit. Check the fields.
errors_generic: This could not be done. Nothing was changed.
mine_intro: Your week, your leave, your authorisations.
week_no_project: You are assigned to no project this week: nothing to answer.
week_ask: One answer a week: how many days on each project?
week_said: You answered: {total} day(s). Answering again replaces it.
leave_route_center: Your request goes to the center’s circuit: it finds who decides.
leave_route_here: No center connected: the request is decided here, by who may approve leave.
people_intro: Who is of the team, and what each one is authorised to do.
people_empty_body: Add a person, or wait for her first request: she joins the list by herself.
person_not_found: This person is not of the team.
assignments_intro: Who works on which project, and when. An assignment is refused when the person does not hold, for the whole period, what the project requires.
assignments_alone: No center connected and no project known: projects come from the center.
requirements_intro: The authorisations anyone assigned to the project must hold.
month_intro: What the accountant needs to prepare the pay: days by project, leave, weeks without an answer. Kete computes no pay.
perm_team_member_body: See one’s page, ask for leave, answer one’s week.
perm_team_read_body: Read people, their authorisations, assignments and leave, and the month’s elements.
perm_team_manage_body: Add a person, record an authorisation, say what a project requires, assign.
perm_team_approve_body: Approve, refuse or send back a leave when the organization has no circuit at the center — never one’s own.
errors_member_not_found: This person is not of the team.
errors_kind_not_found: This authorisation is not tracked here.
errors_authorisation_missing: {person} does not hold the authorisation “{kind}” this project requires: the assignment is refused.
errors_authorisation_expired: The authorisation “{kind}” of {person} does not cover the whole period (valid until {until}): renew it, or shorten the assignment.
errors_period_invalid: The period does not fit: check the dates.
errors_not_of_project: You may not see this project at the center.
errors_assignment_not_found: This assignment does not exist, or no longer.
errors_leave_not_found: This leave does not exist, or no longer.
errors_leave_not_waiting: This leave no longer waits for a decision.
errors_leave_not_returned: This leave was not sent back to you.
errors_decided_at_the_center: This leave is decided in the center’s circuit.
errors_own_request: This is your own request: someone else must decide it.
errors_not_the_requester: Only who asked may do this.
errors_reason_required: Say what is to be corrected.
errors_no_working_day: This period holds no working day.
errors_already_on_leave: You already have a leave on those days.
errors_not_a_monday: A week starts on a Monday.
errors_week_too_long: A week has seven days at most.
errors_not_assigned: You are not assigned to this project that week.
